title: Accelerating Linear Bandits with Persistent Candidate Sets
abstract: arXiv:2610.13407v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Exhaustive optimistic scoring can make action selection costly in linear bandits with a large fixed set of $K$ actions, requiring $\mathcal{O}(K)$ score evaluations per round. We introduce Persistent Candidate LinUCB (\textsc{PC-LinUCB}), which maintains $k$ active actions and samples $q$ challengers uniformly from the remaining $K-k$ actions at each round. By scoring only these $k+q$ candidates, \textsc{PC-LinUCB} reduces the number of score evaluations per round to $\mathcal{O}(k+q)$. We establish problem-independent and problem-dependent high-probability regret bounds consisting of a standard linear-bandit learning term and an additive discovery cost of order $\mathcal{O}\left((K-k)\log(K-k)/q\right)$ at fixed confidence. Notably, this additional cost does not grow with the horizon. For fixed gaps and sufficiently long horizons, we establish an $\Omega\left((K-k)/q\right)$ regret lower bound under uniform challenger sampling, showing

translated_title: 利用持久候选集加速线性老虎机问题
translated_abstract: 在具有大量固定动作集（K 个动作）的线性老虎机问题中，穷举式的乐观打分会使动作选择代价高昂，每轮需要 O(K) 次打分评估。我们提出了持久候选 LinUCB（PC-LinUCB），该方法维护 k 个活跃动作，并在每一轮从其余 K−k 个动作中均匀采样 q 个挑战者。由于只需对这 k+q 个候选动作进行打分，PC-LinUCB 将每轮的打分评估次数降低至 O(k+q)。我们建立了与问题无关和与问题相关的高概率遗憾界，该遗憾界由标准的线性老虎机学习项以及一个在固定置信度下量级为 O((K−k)log(K−k)/q) 的额外发现成本组成。值得注意的是，这一额外成本并不随时间范围增长。对于固定动作间隔和足够长的时间范围，我们在均匀挑战者采样下建立了 Ω((K−k)/q) 的遗憾下界，表明……
tldr: PC-LinUCB 通过维护少量活跃动作并每轮均匀采样挑战者，将线性老虎机每轮打分评估次数从 O(K) 降至 O(k+q)，其额外的发现成本不随时间范围增长，并在均匀采样下达到了 Ω((K−k)/q) 的遗憾下界。
en_tdlr: PC-LinUCB accelerates linear bandits by maintaining k active actions and uniformly sampling q challengers per round, reducing score evaluations from O(K) to O(k+q) with a horizon-independent discovery cost that matches an Ω((K−k)/q) lower bound under uniform sampling.
